# `lakana principal`

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana principal [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage principals.

## `lakana principal create`

Usage: `lakana principal create [OPTIONS] {name}`

Create principal NAME.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--type` | one of `user`, `service-account` | required | user or service-account |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |

## `lakana principal list`

Usage: `lakana principal list [OPTIONS]`

List principals, newest first.

`--search TEXT` lists those whose name contains TEXT, in any letter case. A long list prints a "More results" line with the command that shows the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--search` | text | none | Only names that contain this text, in any letter case. |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | none | Most rows to list (default 100). |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |

## `lakana principal get`

|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |

## `lakana principal deactivate`

Usage: `lakana principal deactivate [OPTIONS] {name}`

Deactivate principal NAME; its credentials stop working.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |

## `lakana principal unlink-provider`

Usage: `lakana principal unlink-provider [OPTIONS] {name}`

Unlink person NAME from the identity provider; they come back with a recovery link.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
